triage.summary: Lucía Martín says her company has changed banks and asks Alex to send future payments to a new IBAN, confirm the records are updated, and stop using the old account. She says the old account closes tomorrow.
triage.risk_reason: The sender requests a change to payment bank details and uses an urgent deadline, a common payment-diversion risk.
